CODE DERIVATION: positional -- the script assigns tipi01..tipi10 in column order to the 10 xlsx columns starting 'Kendimi', id = row index. Each header carries the trait pair in brackets, so mapping_basis=data_labels, and the positional step was checked rather than exempted: header diff 10/10, and re-deriving from the raw xlsx reproduces the live table 4120/4120 cells, 0 disagreeing/unpaired (no two source columns identical; min 249 respondents differ between any pair). Column order is the canonical TIPI order 1-10. TEXT: item_text = bracketed header text verbatim. The shared grid title 'Kendimi ………………………………………… olarak görürüm' (dot leader as in the deposit) ships once in instructions; Atak's longer preamble ('Aşağıda sizi tanımlayan...') is not in the deposit and was deliberately not imported (terseness rule; not confirmed the Form showed it). 10/10 pairs match Atak's Turkish form items 1-10; the only difference is item 3, deposit 'öz disiplinli' vs Atak 'öz-disiplinli' -- the deposit wording ships unchanged. ANCHORS: the deposit carries none (values stored as integers 1-7). option_text 1-7 is Atak's form, which numbers every point explicitly (1 = Tamamen katılmıyorum ... 4 = Kararsızım ... 7 = Tamamen katılıyorum), so all seven ship; not confirmed that the study's Google Form showed these labels. Direction consistent with the data: positive-pole items have the high means (tipi03 5.7, tipi07 5.7) and negative-pole items the low (tipi10 2.6, tipi08 3.1), i.e. the table stores raw, unreversed responses. ENGLISH (_translated): items, anchors and 'I see myself as:' are Gosling's own TIPI English (tipi.pdf) for the same numbered items -- a parallel version, not a translation of the Turkish string -- so translation_source=official_instrument_english; no IRW-generated English. RIGHTS: originator Gosling's TIPI page: 'WANT TO USE THE TIPI? GO AHEAD. ANYONE CAN USE IT FOR ANY PURPOSE. NO NEED TO ASK ME FOR PERMISSION.' On the Turkish translation the same page says: 'As far as I know, you are free to use these translations but as a courtesy I encourage you to contact the contact persons listed below before doing so.' -- a courtesy request, not a reserved right (no fee, permission, NC, ND or redistribution term); Atak's docx states no terms. Item wording itself came from the CC BY 4.0 deposit. No register row written (rounds may not write ship rows); escalated as ship-shaped with the quotes above. Informational: TIPI domain-pair correlations are weak in this sample (E -0.32, C -0.06, O -0.02, A +0.16, ES +0.07), a known TIPI property that does not bear on the code mapping, which the cell-level re-derivation settles.
